newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH METROSTAV SETS RIGHTS ISSUE AT CZK 1,500.
newsitem.headline: CZECH METROSTAV SETS RIGHTS ISSUE AT CZK 1,500.

text.p: Czech construction company Metrostav a.s. has opened the first round of a 150 million crown rights issue priced at 500 crown premium over the 1,000 crown nominal value, the company said in a published statement.
It said the first round was open on January 17, offering the stock to current shareholders until January 30. The remainder will be publicly offered in the second round.
The 1,500 crown issuing price will remain the same for the second round, Metrostav said.
The issue is underwritten by bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. .
The equity expansion will bring Metrostav's basic capital to 659 million crowns.
Metrostav shares are listed on the main market of the Prague Stock Exchange. The stock rose eight crowns in Monday's trading to close at 2,762 crowns.
Two investment funds managed by Sporitelna's investment arm, SPIF Vynosovy and SPIF Cesky , hold a combined 33 percent stake in Metrostav.
